text:
Lina (support): FYI: ACME customer hit 503s during a rapid 2k rps spike this morning. They say the dedicated pool didn't scale up for ~40–60s. Customer seeing errors and latency in prod. stack: dedicated/gpu-eu-west. customer-req-id: req_0a1b2c3d
Tom (eng-oncall): ah, thanks. any repro steps/trace ids? do we have autoscaler events or probe logs?
Lina (support): Repro steps from customer: 1) warm idle for 10m, 2) send 2k rps for 30s to route /v1/generate, 3) ~20% responses 503 then gradual recovery. They attached a snippet of client errors: 

curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-medium","input":"hi"}'

Response: HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c3d

They also pasted agent logs showing repeated probe 429s: 
[2026-03-10T09:02:12Z] probe: rate limit -> HTTP 429 (probe_id=42)
[2026-03-10T09:02:12Z] attach: pending (pod=ded-123)
[2026-03-10T09:02:20Z] autoscaler: scale-up requested -> +6 replicas (desired=10)
[2026-03-10T09:02:55Z] autoscaler: scale-up applied -> +6 replicas ready=2

Lina (support): Customer mentions min_replicas=2, max_replicas=50, burst_policy=ephemeral, reserved_capacity=0. They suspect noisy-tenants in same pool.
scalebot: Alert: dedicated-pool gpu-eu-west utilization spike at 2026-03-10T09:02:11Z -> 92% (see /dash/pool/gpu-eu-west)
Raj (eng-platform): Can you paste the autoscaler events from /api/internal/autoscaler/events for the timeframe? also we need scheduler/kube events and imagepull/backoff lines.
Lina (support): Pasting trimmed autoscaler events from customer account: 
- 09:02:10 scale_request: target_replicas=10 reason=throughput
- 09:02:11 probe_rejected rate_limit=true
- 09:02:12 schedule_delay reason=attach-queue
- 09:02:55 scale_applied replicas_ready=2

Olivia (customer-success): I talked to the customer — they were on a usage spike from a marketing campaign and can't increase budget for reserved capacity right now. They want a quick mitigation to avoid 503s.
Tom (eng-oncall): Initial hypothesis: probe pacing/rate-limit on warmpool attach is causing attach handshake to queue; combined with noisy neighbor GPU saturation causing kube to schedule slower -> effective scaleup lag. We should check controller logs for attach handshake timeout and kube-scheduler backoff.
Leah (sre): I'll pull kube events for the cluster and check pod startup timings. Also check whether the image pull throughput or node provisioning was the bottleneck. If pods created but not Ready, look at init-container wait.
Lina (support): Quick customer mitigation options suggested: 1) temporarily raise min_replicas from 2 -> 6, 2) enable per-customer reserved burst (if allowed), 3) flip fallback to hosted small model for a short window. Customer asked for option 1 but wants us to confirm safety.
Raj (eng-platform): Option 1 is safest and fastest. We can apply a short-lived override on their deployment config. But we need to confirm not hitting account quota or billing hold. Also check rate-limit config on probes: the default probe qps is 10/s -> might plateau scale. I'm going to run: 

# check autoscaler queue depth
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" https://internal.api.redwood.ai/autoscaler/queue?pool=gpu-eu-west&since=2026-03-10T09:01:00Z | jq '.'

Raj (eng-platform): result: queue_peak=68 attach_retries=12 probe_429s=18 average_handshake=4.6s -> explains delay.
Tom (eng-oncall): Let's apply the temporary min_replicas bump and open a short support window. Lina — can you confirm customer acceptance? Also we'll keep an eye for noisy tenant shaping.
Lina (support): Customer approved immediate bump to min_replicas=6 for 1 hour. I've created support ticket SUP-9281 and warned about potential short billing bump.
Leah (sre): I dug into kube events: several pods hit NodeSelectorReject for GPU type due to transient capacity fragmentation; scheduler retried -> podPending extra ~22s. Also saw imagepull backoff once (registry slow) causing ~8s delay on 1 pod. Combined with probe rate-limit and attach queue -> scale applied but pods Ready lagged.
Tom (eng-oncall): Root cause summary for customer: rapid burst + probe rate-limiting + transient GPU node fragmentation + one image-pull backoff -> effective scale-up lag and 503s. Mitigation applied: min_replicas=6 for 1h; also increased probe QPS for this pool to 20/s temporarily. We'll monitor.
Raj (eng-platform): Action items: - follow-up: add autoscaler metric for probe_429s -> alert threshold - infra: investigate noisy-tenant placement policy to reduce fragmentation - product: consider short-lived reserve option for burst campaigns
Olivia (customer-success): Customer is happy with temp fix, asked for a writeup. I'll send them the summary and cost estimate. :white_check_mark:
Lina (support): I'll keep thread updated with metrics. closing loop after 2h observation. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
